title: Halloween Weekend: Wilton Manors and South Beach
igCaption:
Wilton Manors and South Beach for Halloween weekend.
Oct. 31, Wilton Manors and South Beach.

Sources: WPLG Local 10, WSVN, Miami New Times

#MiamiEvents #WiltonManors #SouthBeach #Halloween

scenes.text: Looking for Halloween this weekend? Start with Wilton Manors, then head to South Beach.
WPLG Local 10 called Wicked Manors one big party and one spooktacular show. WSVN also said South Florida is preparing for large Halloween parties in Wilton Manors and Wynwood.
scenes.caption: WPLG Local 10 called Wicked Manors 1 big party and 1 spooktacular show. WSVN also said South Florida is preparing for large Halloween parties in Wilton Manors and Wynwood.

scenes.text: South Beach is the late-night stop. The map puts it at 25.781875 latitude and -80.136262 longitude. If you end up in South Beach late, check NEAR for who’s around.

scenes.text: Which one are you doing first, Wilton Manors or South Beach? That stranger in costume you kept noticing all night is exactly the kind of face NEAR turns into a name, without the awkward ask.
